content.tagline: The science behind restoring scalp and hair balance
content.descriptor: Korean biotech company: HAIRREGEON and HERIBON brands
about: CK Regeon Inc. is a Korean biotech company founded in 2016 in Seoul (Yonsei Engineering Research Park). It is led by Professor Kang-Yell Choi, a Wnt-signalling researcher with more than twenty years of experience in regenerative science. The company’s cosmetics portfolio is united under the DermaRegeon name and consists of two lines: HAIRREGEON for the professional channel and HERIBON for daily home care.

Behind both lines sit ten years of Wnt-signalling research, five patents in the US, the EU, Korea and China, and — as stated by the company — regulatory notifications secured across nine countries. The "WNT ON" technology works through the CXXC5 protein: PTD-DBM and KY19382 disrupt its binding to Dishevelled and restore suppressed Wnt/β-catenin signalling in scalp cells. The mechanism is described in peer-reviewed journals — Journal of Investigative Dermatology (2017), British Journal of Pharmacology (2020 and 2021), Cells (2023) and Journal of Experimental Medicine (2015).

Important for accurate communication: the published research describes the mechanism of action of the components at a preclinical level — cell culture, ex vivo and pilot-study observations — and does not confirm the clinical efficacy of the finished products. HAIRREGEON and HERIBON are made and sold as cosmetics, not medical devices, and are not positioned as a cure for alopecia.
facts: Published in JID, BJP, Cells and JEM
channels: Salons, dermatology clinics and trichology studios

lines.name: HAIRREGEON
lines.note: A professional line for intensive cosmetic scalp care — for clinics, salons and trichology studios. The flagship is the PTD-DBM Hair Booster: a two-part set of a vial with 200 mg of lyophilised powder and a 5 ml diluent vial, five sets per box. It is mixed immediately before the session; the company recommends pairing it with MTS microneedling at 0.5–1.5 mm every two weeks and notes that a visible result is usually observed after twelve weeks of treatment. Manufactured to ISO 22716, 36-month shelf life.

lines.name: HERIBON
lines.note: A daily "WNT ON" home-care line in four steps, in order of use: scalp scaler 300 ml, shampoo 500 ml, hair treatment 250 ml and a leave-in tonic 50 ml. Suitable for every scalp type — sensitive, oily and dry; free from parabens, sulfates and artificial colorants. Shelf life is 36 months unopened; after opening the company recommends use within 12 months.

tech.name: "WNT ON" technology
tech.note: The company’s own development. PTD-DBM and KY19382 inhibit CXXC5, which the company identifies as a key driver of hair loss, and restore suppressed Wnt/β-catenin signalling in scalp cells — moving the pathway from "WNT OFF" to "WNT ON".

tech.name: PTD-DBM peptide
tech.note: The active component of the professional HAIRREGEON line. Its competitive CXXC5-binding mechanism is described at a preclinical level in a Journal of Investigative Dermatology (2017) publication.

tech.name: MetaAct and KY19382
tech.note: MetaAct, a PKM2 activator, works alongside PTD-DBM in HAIRREGEON and amplifies Wnt-pathway activation. KY19382 is the active component of HERIBON, patented in the US, the EU, Korea and China; the reddish tone of HERIBON products comes from KY19382 itself, not from a colorant.

tech.name: Patents and publications
tech.note: Five registered patents in the US, the EU, Korea and China — covering the WNT Hair composition and the PTD-DBM peptide itself. The mechanism is described in four peer-reviewed journals: Journal of Investigative Dermatology (2017), British Journal of Pharmacology (2020 and 2021), Cells (2023) and Journal of Experimental Medicine (2015).

content.seoDesc: CK Regeon — Korean biotech company behind HAIRREGEON and HERIBON: WNT ON technology, five patents in the US, EU, Korea and China, MoCRA, CPNP, SCPN and Dermatest registrations. Wholesale supply and deal support through Teranova.
catalog_notes: A professional two-part set for intensive cosmetic scalp care: a vial with 200 mg of lyophilised PTD-DBM powder and a 5 ml diluent vial. The contents of the second vial are transferred into the first and fully dissolved immediately before the session. Under the company protocol the standard in-clinic dose is about 5 ml by mesotherapy per session, adjusted for diffuse or localised hair loss and scalp sensitivity. The company lists contraindications: known ingredient allergy; active scalp infection, psoriasis, eczema or open wounds; pregnancy and breastfeeding as a precaution. Pack of 5 sets.

A daily "WNT ON" shampoo — the second step of the four-step routine, after the scaler. Cleanses the scalp and hair gently, refreshing and keeping a clean, lightweight feel. Free from parabens, sulfates and artificial colorants. 500 ml.
The scalp scaler is the first step: massage for 2–3 minutes and rinse. It clears dead cells and excess sebum from the scalp before the main routine. 300 ml.
A "WNT ON" hair treatment mask — the third step: softens, hydrates and eases combing while giving hair a fuller feel. 250 ml.
A leave-in scalp tonic — the final step of the routine, used 2–3 times a week. Applied evenly, not rinsed off, and leaves no stickiness. 50 ml.
